name: Anchor posture — what is signed, what is anchored, what is neither
principle: A measurement body that asks others to show their provenance must publish its own. This door states the posture including the parts that are absent.

root_json.probe: curl -s https://councilof.ai/root.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('sig_ed25519' in d)"

anchored.note: This is the number of INDEPENDENT anchors the estate holds. Copy claiming more than this is an overclaim however it is phrased.

root_json.detail: The deployed root.json carries no ots, opentimestamps, anchor or rekor field of any kind. It is signed and it is not anchored.
root_json.closes_when: an OpenTimestamps proof over the single Merkle root is published and UPGRADED by a calendar

rails.name: Bitcoin OpenTimestamps
rails.why: Stamped is not anchored. A fresh stamp carries a PendingAttestation and becomes a proof only once a calendar commits it to a Bitcoin block and the proof is UPGRADED. Until then it proves submission, not inclusion.

rails.name: Sigstore Rekor
rails.why: Counted in live_anchors. This is the one of the three that is genuinely live today.

rails.name: Ethereum Attestation Service on Base
rails.why: Code exists and refuses to mint. Nothing has been issued. EAS is valid only as a chain LABEL on rows explicitly marked UNMEASURED.

what_this_does_not_establish: No claim that the root is anchored. It is not.
No claim that OTS stamping has occurred, or that a stamp would constitute an anchor before a calendar upgrade.
No claim that any EAS attestation exists. The rail has issued nothing.
Three live anchors is the ceiling. Any copy asserting a fourth is an overclaim.
doctrine: UNMEASURED is first-class. So is UNANCHORED. Stating the absence is the point of this door.
